edges.effect_quant: Pooled meta-analytic evidence suggest a small average effect that is directionally consistent but not dramatic.
edges.mechanism: EPA and DHA lower hepatic VLDL production, shift membrane lipid signaling, and can modestly dampen inflammatory eicosanoid tone. Those mechanisms matter most for Depression when baseline triglycerides are high or the outcome is tightly linked to cardiometabolic inflammation.
edges.summary: Pooled meta-analytic evidence link omega-3 (epa/dha) to lower risk of depression in adults with depressive symptoms. The average effect is usually small rather than dramatic, so this edge is better read as a risk modifier than a stand-alone cause or cure.
edges.caveats: Dose, timing, and baseline risk still matter. Observational edges may partly reflect broader lifestyle patterning, while small trials can overstate benefit if follow-up is short.
